purpose: Track recurring attack classes, ontology leakage patterns, accepted defenses, unresolved debts, and governance constraints derived from adversarial review.

series_anchor.objective: Create the adversarial hardening governance layer before theory backfill patches.
series_anchor.ruling: Because the repo already has governance gates, registries, validators, manifests, and claim controls, adversarial hardening enters as governance infrastructure before theory rewrites.

governance_principles.title: Whole Expression Primacy
governance_principles.rule: No aspect, operator, operand, projection, or derived structure may be granted ontological priority over RT/Core without explicit governance approval.
governance_principles.rationale: Repeated adversarial attacks succeeded by isolating aspects and treating them as independent primitives.

governance_principles.title: Aspect Decomposition Governance
governance_principles.rule: Analytical decomposition is permitted for inspection but does not imply ontological independence.
governance_principles.rationale: Affect, Effect, Residue, Admissibility, Relation, and Projection may be analyzed separately without becoming foundational.

governance_principles.title: Meta-Level Declaration Requirement
governance_principles.rule: All critiques, patches, and formal arguments must declare the primary meta-level being addressed.
governance_principles.rationale: Prevent illicit movement between abstraction layers.

governance_principles.title: Array Classification Requirement
governance_principles.rule: All array structures must declare classification before they are used in claims, patches, or textbook formalization.
governance_principles.rationale: Prevent conditional, residue, projection, and participation arrays from being collapsed into a hidden state ontology.

governance_principles.title: Residue Inscription Mode Requirement
governance_principles.rule: All residue claims must declare inscription mode before they are used as explanatory or evidentiary support.
governance_principles.rationale: Residue claims drift when realized continuation inscription and excluded-boundary inscription are left implicit.

governance_principles.title: Implementation Artifact Firewall
governance_principles.rule: Implementation artifacts may not be used as ontology evidence.
governance_principles.rationale: Simulation clocks, loops, addresses, array layout, and execution order are implementation conveniences rather than direct ontology witnesses.

attack_classes.name: whole_expression_fragmentation
attack_classes.risk: Treats an inspected aspect as if it were a standalone primitive.

attack_classes.name: ontology_leakage_by_projection
attack_classes.risk: Slides from projection language into substance or identity language.

attack_classes.name: meta_level_slippage
attack_classes.risk: Moves between RT/Core, participation, admissibility, and projection levels without declaration.

attack_classes.name: implementation_artifact_reification
attack_classes.risk: Uses code structure, execution order, array layout, or platform behavior as ontology evidence.

accepted_defenses.name: whole_expression_compliance
accepted_defenses.description: Restate arguments at the whole-expression level before aspect analysis is permitted.

accepted_defenses.name: declared_meta_level
accepted_defenses.description: Require every critique, patch, theorem note, and rewrite to declare its governing meta-level.

accepted_defenses.name: array_classification
accepted_defenses.description: Force every array-bearing formalism to declare conditional, projection, residue, or participation status.

accepted_defenses.name: residue_inscription_mode
accepted_defenses.description: Require explicit Psi_plus or Psi_minus declaration for residue-bearing claims.

accepted_defenses.name: implementation_firewall
accepted_defenses.description: Block execution artifacts from being cited as direct ontology support.

attack_classification_system.definition: Demonstrates incompatible claims at the same declared meta-level.
Identifies missing definitions, operators, or governance.
Imports substance-ontology assumptions into process-ontology structures.

residue_governance.rule: All process outcomes must declare inscription mode.

array_governance.rule: Every array structure must declare its ontological classification.

implementation_governance.rule: Implementation artifacts shall not be used as ontological evidence.
implementation_governance.rationale: Implementation convenience does not define framework ontology.
